description: Source code for Nordic Semiconductor NRF RTC counter driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing timer/counter functionalities with PPI and IRQ handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the RTC counter by triggering the start task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the RTC counter by triggering the stop task.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the current counter value from the RTC.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current counter value.

methods.name: ticks_sub
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two counter values considering wrap.

methods.name: skip_zero_on_custom_top
methods.description: Adjusts CC value if zero when custom top is used.

methods.name: ticks_add
methods.description: Adds two counter values considering wrap.

methods.name: set_cc_int_pending
methods.description: Sets the compare channel interrupt as pending.

methods.name: handle_next_tick_case
methods.description: Handles setting CC when value equals counter+1.

methods.name: set_cc
methods.description: Sets the compare channel value with late setting detection.

methods.name: set_channel_alarm
methods.description: Configures an alarm on a specific channel.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a specific alarm channel.

methods.name: cancel_alarm
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled alarm on a channel.

methods.name: ppi_setup
methods.description: Sets up PPI channels for RTC events.

methods.name: ppi_free
methods.description: Frees PPI channels used by RTC.

methods.name: sw_wrap_required
methods.description: Determines if software wrap is needed based on top value.

methods.name: set_fixed_top_value
methods.description: Sets a fixed top value for the counter.

methods.name: set_top_value
methods.description: Configures the top value for the counter, handling wrap and alarms.

methods.name: get_pending_int
methods.description: Returns pending interrupts (stub implementation).

methods.name: init_rtc
methods.description: Initializes the RTC hardware with prescaler.

methods.name: get_top_value
methods.description: Returns the current top value of the counter.

methods.name: get_guard_period
methods.description: Returns the guard period value.

methods.name: set_guard_period
methods.description: Sets the guard period value.

methods.name: top_irq_handle
methods.description: Handles top overflow IRQ, calls callback if set.

methods.name: alarm_irq_handle
methods.description: Handles alarm IRQ for a specific channel, calls callback.

methods.name: irq_handler
methods.description: Main IRQ handler, processes top and alarm events.
